title: Node.js 22
description: Node.js 22 LTS for RideTube Plus's service, the same program as RideTube's jap-node22 22.23.4: nodejs.org's unofficial linux-x64-glibc-217 build (the unit has glibc 2.27), its loader set to /lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2, at /var/opt/jap-node22/current/bin/node; BMW's apps keep the system Node 8. Shipped as node.xz and unpacked at install by mgu-python.
